verdict.rationale: OpenHands is itself an AI agent product. Users delegate work by typing natural-language tasks in the CLI, through the web GUI, or by @mentioning it in Slack, and they can pause, resume, and auto-approve the agent's actions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation quality, since all evidence is first-party docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Type natural language tasks and receive instant feedback
Watch Slack channels for @openhands mentions, open a conversation with the message context, and reply when the agent finishes.
Agent Canvas is the open-source browser client and control center for agent conversations and automations.
